description.value: Penticton Lakeside Resort & Conference Centre sits on the shores of Okanagan Lake, offering a private licensed beach, marina, boat rentals, pool, hot tub, and a floating sauna. Three on-site restaurants — The Bufflehead Cafe, The Barking Parrot Bar, and The Hooded Merganser — all have pet-friendly patios, and the resort is steps from Okanagan Lake Park and surrounding trail networks. It serves as a full-service base for cyclists exploring the South Okanagan wine country and rail trails.

address.value: 21 Lakeshore Drive West, Penticton, BC V2A 7M5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active (copyright 2026, functional booking system) and confirms this is a full-service lakeside resort. The amenities page lists three on-site restaurants and various recreational facilities, but no bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those are null. EV charging stations (Mercedes-Benz and SWTCH) are listed on the amenities page but are vehicle-oriented and cannot be confirmed as e-bike-compatible. OSM tags and the website contact page agree on phone number and address.
concerns: OSM name ('Penticton Lakeside Resort') omits '& Conference Centre' relative to the website name ('Penticton Lakeside Resort & Conference Centre').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating full-service resort with confirmed web presence, multiple dining options, and broad amenities — a useful stop for touring cyclists in Penticton.
enrichment_extras.notes: Amenities page lists Mercedes-Benz and SWTCH EV charging stations; these appear vehicle-oriented and cannot be confirmed as e-bike compatible without further information.
